title: Repair a damaged relayed decision with one command, whether or not it is committed
description: Repair a damaged relayed decision with one command, whether or not it is committed
acceptance_criteria: When one of those records is damaged, I am told one command that repairs it, whether or not it has been committed yet.
That repair puts the original back when a copy of it still exists, and otherwise removes only the damaged record, never the approval or review it belongs to.
The repair tells me what it put back and what it removed.

answers.constraints: change.3md 'Approvals are claims; relayed decisions (#633)': the relay is the one evidence shape read strictly (null and unknown keys refused, decided_by must be the record's actor or reviewer) and its refusals go through with_relayed_read_recovery, which names git checkout HEAD and does not cover a review file that is not committed (#904); this change keeps the strict read and changes only the named recovery. REQ-change-046: review attempts are append-only and no blocking result may be erased, so the repair never removes an approval or an attempt and never edits a verdict. 'Keep it out' (Leif, 2026-11-05 20:19 MST via orc t18): no digest or gate reads a relay, so a repair stales no approval, verification or review. Leif (2026-11-06 06:1x MST via orc t18, 'Ok yes I approve all'): with no surviving copy, remove only the damaged relayed_by rather than refuse. Files are written the way SpecSync writes them (json_content), all in one step under the project lock. Never weaken a gate, bound or test.
